response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced generalist software engineer (15+ years across web, backend, embedded, and mobile) with recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, MCP tooling, and agentic workflows at re:cinq. However, his hands-on GenAI experience appears to span only a few months, falling well short of the required 8+ years building production AI-driven solutions, and the resume shows no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, evaluation pipelines, or LLM optimization. Strong engineering fundamentals and teaching/mentoring history keep him in consideration, but the core GenAI depth expected at staff level is unproven.
strengths: 15+ years of production software engineering with strong Python-adjacent polyglot skills (TypeScript, Node.js, D, C++)
Recent hands-on work with MCP code generators and agentic-workflow infrastructure, directly relevant to key technologies
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge-sharing via workshops, conference talks, and courses, aligning with customer-facing leadership duties
concerns: Only ~4 months of documented GenAI/agentic experience vs. the required 8+ years of AI-driven solution development
No evidence of RAG, vector databases, LLM evaluation pipelines, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI
Limited depth in major cloud platform architecture (AWS CDK usage noted, but no AI systems designed on cloud at scale)
